description: On a writable copy of the base fixture TableDef U's Attributes is set to dbHiddenObject (1) and W's to dbSystemObject (-2147483648), each read back with DBEngine.Errors. TableDefs (after Refresh) are listed with Name and Attributes, and the rows of U and W are read. After Close and reopen the TableDefs are listed again.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
